sloka: पूजनीयः च मान्यः च राजा दण्डधरो गुरुः ।इन्द्रस्य एव चतुर्भागः प्रजा रक्षति राघव ॥३-१-१९॥
transliteration: pūjanīyaḥ ca mānyaḥ ca rājā daṇḍadharo guruḥ ।indrasya eva caturbhāgaḥ prajā rakṣati rāghava ॥3-1-19॥

translations.english: O Rama, in this world a king is considered the fourth part of Indra as he protects the people. Therefore, he is respected and he enjoys the choicest pleasures of life.
